questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Titans or Rhinos?
Who has achieved the fifty and 4 wickets in a match double more times, Sunette Loubser or Lizelle Lee?
questions.explanation: Sunette Loubser: 1 times. Lizelle Lee: 4 times.

questions.question: Cobras set a database record (T20) with a value of 71. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Wins', held by Cobras.

questions.question: Which team has finished runner-up more times than any other in this database (7), despite winning the title only twice in that span?
questions.explanation: Lions finished runner-up 7 times across List A and T20 Division 1 between 2012/13 and 2025/26, but won the title only twice.

questions.question: Who has more runs — Shafeeqa Pillay or Lerato Langa? (combined T20 + List A.)

questions.explanation: Elzaan Pietersen & Monique Booysen hold it, with a total of 229.
